claim_boundary: This artifact proves an exact actual-Farey cell/jittered-node/multiplicative-ray reduction and a conditional FARI implication. It proves neither FARI nor CRR-U, and gives no witness, cubic lower bound, density estimate, prime-interval theorem, saturation theorem, or L-function result.

conditional_incompatibility_reduction.conclusion: For sufficiently large v with 3*delta(v)<eta, Base(v) and RationalMass(v) cannot hold together; hence FARI_eta implies CRR-U.
conditional_incompatibility_reduction.scope: PositiveCubic(v) is not needed for this conditional contradiction; this does not prove FARI_eta or CRR-U.

context.finite_probe_scope: Metadata correction only. It does not edit or rerun v3, alter any row, seed, candidate, numerical value, status, resource observation, or mathematical claim.
context.montgomery_scope: This artifact proves exact exponent algebra and finite-threshold implications conditional on two explicitly CONJECTURED premises. It proves neither Montgomery's conjecture nor CRR-U, and it gives no density, prime-interval, saturation, or L-function theorem.

distinctions_from_prior_work.finite_probe: The equal-weight finite surrogate did not test this continuous cross-Gram/FARI condition and supplies no universal negative.
distinctions_from_prior_work.generic_alias_barrier: The pinned alias barrier excludes actual Farey nodes; its generic no-go is not invoked here.

affine_factorization.scale: if d,e,m2,m3 asymp M and r asymp Q, numerator and denominator are asymp Q
affine_factorization.scope: dyadic-scale compatibility only; no exact-shell closure or coprimality preservation is asserted

falsifiers.fari: An asymptotic Base-plus-RationalMass family satisfying the forced bundle lower bound refutes every FARI_eta that covers it.
falsifiers.reduction: A failure of Farey-cell disjointness, the smoothing selector, the plateau-ray count, or the labeled cross-Gram identity would refute the proved reduction.

fari_target.arithmetic_content: actual reduced Farey nodes, bounded archimedean jitter, multiplicative rays, and one common Dirichlet measurement matrix
fari_target.not_claimed: No proof or disproof of this restricted inverse inequality is supplied.
fari_target.statement: For some fixed eta>0 and all sufficiently large v, every H^(1/100)-separated Base-admissible W satisfies B_v(W)<=v^(26-eta).

forced_bundle_lower.definition: B_v(W)=sum_(r,s in F_Q) sup_(|theta|<=3) sum_(k in K_(r,s)) |C_theta(sk,rk)|^2

multiplicative_ray_cross_gram.entry_injectivity: (r,s,k)->(sk,rk) is injective for reduced positive r/s

rationalmass_to_jittered_farey_lift.selection_note: The jitter is retained; positive smoothing alone does not center x_(r,s) at r/s.
